run_getCriteoAdData: run getCriteoAdData to preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte dataset into npz format
run_loadDataset: run loadDataset to load and preprocess kaggle or terabyte Criteo advertising dataset
run_cli_preprocess: run the CLI module to preprocess Criteo dataset with configurable max index range and subsampling
run_transformCriteoAdData: run transformCriteoAdData to apply log transformation on dense features and split into train val test sets
run_processCriteoAdData: run processCriteoAdData to convert categorical features to integers and clamp negative dense values
